note: 京师 (d/city): the 青石 驿道 from 玉螺湖村 between its two small woods to the 北门, old and red (大红颜色), its gold words; the city behind its grey walls, roofs packed close in dark tiles, the streets of worn blue-grey stone; 护国道 from the 西一门 to the 东一门 past the 钱庄 and the 武器店, the ochre walls and green roofs of 护国寺; down the axis the empty altar square, the 紫禁城's vermilion wall and gold roofs between 神武门 in its chains and 午门 between its lions, the trodden yellow of the 校武场, the 天桥's stalls and lanterns; the 西街's 太白酒楼 all gilt, the 东街 pressed between the palace wall and the 尚书府's; the 南街, the 监狱's high wall, the 刑场, the 民宅's smoke, the 南门. Five outer gates shut, each its own.
